notes: Evidence anchors: round2 run.log ends with TRAN: Timestep too small; time = 0.000390766, timestep = 1.25e-19: trouble with node "b_sw#branch", followed by run simulation(s) aborted, after No. of Data Rows : 140493. The last Reference value 3.90743e-04 coincides with the abort time, so those lines are simulation-time stamps, not Vref measurements. Round1 b_low excerpt only shows time stamps to about 1.77e-3 s and no abort text; it does not demonstrate a stall. Fixture b_flyback.inc has VQ drain sw 0 in series with X_Q sw gate source, so b_sw#branch is the VQ drain-current branch; an ideal 0-V source with a switched MOSFET model and only 1e-14 F cshunt per added capacitor can produce discontinuous branch current at a switching edge. The demonstrated failure is numerical timestep collapse localized to the switch branch, not proof of controller latch, transformer saturation, or hardware shutdown. Winding polarity: SPICE dot is the first node; LPOWER(primary,drain) has its dot on the input side and LSEC(0,secondary) has its dot at ground. In this orientation the on-state drives the secondary non-dot negative (diode reverse-biased) and the off-state drives it positive (diode forward), so relative polarity is flyback-correct; the excerpts contain no original transformer dot data to prove a source mismatch. Reference: device_facts gives LM3488 FB 1.26 V typ (1.24-1.28 V), TI model header 1.26 V, upstream ASC 1.22 V. The vref126 fixture already uses 1.26 V and still aborts at 0.391 ms, so Vref mismatch is not a sufficient cause. R_FB1=1.2Meg/R_FB2=8674 gives about 175.6 V at 1.26 V (170.0 V at 1.22 V); the upstream 179.5-180 V is not reproduced by this arithmetic, so the setpoint is unverified. Limitations: no terminal error in the b_low excerpt, no complete original deck, no transformer dot/polarity data, no board parasitics or measurements; model abort cannot be equated to hardware behavior. Decision-relevant verification: (1) rerun the exact b_pin_step_vref126 deck and confirm t=390.766 us and b_sw#branch; (2) keep LM3488_TRANS and IRFH7185, add a physical drain-source RC snubber or measured drain loop inductance (start from board Coss/layout; 100 pF + 10 ohm is only a diagnostic) and rerun; a numerical-only check is .options cshunt=1e-12 or method=gear, and if the abort moves or clears treat it as switching-edge numerical stiffness; (3) verify the transformer dot convention against the original transformer drawing and the FB divider against the 1.26 V datasheet before using 1.22 V. Minimal fix hypothesis: retain both real-device models, damp the switch node physically, and accept only if the abort clears without replacing the controller or MOSFET with a behavioral proxy.
